verdict.rationale: Ironclad's own no-code contract builder and Workflow Designer, plus a hands-on community note praising its "intelligent templatized form entry," point to guided, form-driven document generation. The same hands-on report notes there is no preview and the steps are rigidly linear. Flagging choices for attorney review is supported only by a passing mention that the platform handles approval policies. missing for 10: documented questionnaire/intake-form mechanics, evidence that answers populate documents correctly, explicit flagging of risky choices for attorney review, and independent current corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can answer guided questionnaires that fill in legal documents correctly and flag choices that need attorney review

citations.quote: Doing intelligent templatized form entry seems really convenient
leaving the specifics around updating contract language and following approval and signature policies to the Ironclad platform
